review.notes: Round-2 review of the rewritten package; accepted after in-place corrections. The revision meets every request of the first review: Suggested.lean is 403 lines in namespace TauCetiRoadmap.AutomorphicSpectralTheory with no sorry'd data (scripts/check_sorry_data.py clean), no stand-in carriers and no atlas ids; the README is in upstream form with Summary, Scope and ownership, Conventions, supplier contracts, How to read the build, layers with Checks, Examples and Dependencies, and References; slugs and B/S labels are gone; Franke clause (c) is the new target section 5.14. lean-check, before and after the edits: exit 0, no errors, 57 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry'. Fidelity: all 190 plan targets are present (the projection-valued measure as a supplier contract, since OperatorTheory owns it); the six added sections are the targets moved down from higher tiers, Franke clause (c), and the Euclidean Paley-Wiener prerequisite added here; every definition has at least three Checks. Sources: 95 locators were opened and all were correct (Arthur's trace-formula notes, Duke-Imamoglu-Toth 2016, Gross-Zagier, Yu, Franke, Clozel-Delorme, Jiang-Zhang, Teschl, Moeglin-Waldspurger). The previous review had already checked the explicit formulas numerically; this pass checked every Lean statement and every new Check by hand, and all hold. Corrections made: supplier contracts (upstream identifiers diagMeasure, proj_inter and borelCalculus; SelfAdjointSpectralTheory Part E does not state the representation A = integral of t dP_A, now part of section 0.6; the Hilbert-Schmidt ideal bound is OI-B40; no OperatorIdeals item says HS times HS is trace class, so that is a new API item of section 0.9 from Teschl Lemma 6.13; the resolvent API is Tau Ceti's TauCeti.LinearPMap, not Mathlib's; ALS.F.5 is the (g,K) version; transitivity of constant terms is AutomorphicFormsOnReductiveGroups Layer 3, not ALS.F.6; AL Layer 0 does not supply Euclidean Paley-Wiener; SR.3 Langlands classification is conditional). Also replaced the nonexistent name PaleyWienerBound.mul_of_polynomialGrowth with the target spectral_multiplier_growth; fixed a mis-substitution in 6.32 ('[Yetter04]' for the unit circle); replaced garbled or Lean-fixture Checks in 0.3, 1.2, 1.4, 1.9, 4.11, 6.4, 6.10, 6.11 and 6.19; turned inline Checks in 1.10 and 6.8 into lists; turned the 105 'Throughout this statement, assume X' remnants into '*Standing hypotheses:*'; normalised citation keys; removed six uncited references; added MW89 and MW94 and the free arXiv version of ACC+23; rewrote How to read the build to give an acyclic build order for the modular and function-field branches, which cite later-numbered sections (21 such edges, no cycles). One gap remains, recorded in section 1.6: the Euclidean Paley-Wiener theorem is in neither library nor any supplier roadmap and has no proof locator. intake.py check-files: 0 problems. metadata.toml: math.NT. Report: research/blueprint/reviews/REV-PKG-AutomorphicSpectralTheory~2.md.
